D5/S3/HilbertOperators/WoldDecomposition.name: D5.S3.HilbertOperators.WoldDecomposition.exists_wold_decomposition
D5/S3/HilbertOperators/WoldDecomposition.signature: theorem exists_wold_decomposition (V : H →ₗᵢ[𝕜] H) (x : H) (n : ℕ) : ∃ w : ℕ → H, ∃ y : H, (∀ k, w k ∈ wanderingSub V) ∧ (∀ k ≥ n, w k = 0) ∧ x = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (V ^ k) (w k)) + (V ^ n) y ∧ ‖x‖ ^ 2 = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ‖w k‖ ^ 2) + ‖y‖ ^ 2
